==Objectives==
Find proof of the Blood Elf plot in [[Felstrider Retreat]].
*[[Rommath's Orders]]

==Description==
Our... former brethren have fortified themselves in the mountain fortress of [[Felstrider Retreat]]. They've been here even before we arrived to settle these lands, and I suspect they may be remnants of [[Kael'thas Sunstrider|Kael]]'s forces that did not sail to [[Northrend]]. Up until now, they haven't caused much trouble, and quite embarrassingly, we've been overlooking their presence. However, if what you say is true, they must be plotting something.

I need you to find evidence of their plot. Perhaps one of their soldiers carries orders that could shed more light on the matter. May the Light guide you, friend.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*850 XP
*+150 [[reputation]] with [[Silvermoon Remnant]]

==Progress==
Have you found anything?

==Completion==
Rommath?

That rat, that vermin! He's the one who betrayed [[Vereesa Windrunner|Vereesa]], siding with [[Astalor Sunsworn|Astalor]], and now this? He will hang for his treachery.

But first, deliver this news to Lady Vereesa. I sense there's something more to it...
